description: Internal Node.js module for resolving ECMAScript modules (ESM) specifiers, including package and subpath resolution, handling of package.json configurations, and integration with CommonJS resolution fallback.

methods.name: emitFolderMapDeprecation
methods.description: Emits a deprecation warning for folder mappings in package.json's 'exports' or 'imports' fields.

methods.name: getConditionsSet
methods.description: Returns a set of conditions for module resolution based on provided conditions or defaults.

methods.name: tryStatSync
methods.description: Attempts to synchronously get file stats, returning an empty Stats object on failure.

methods.name: getPackageConfig
methods.description: Reads and caches package.json configuration for a given path.

methods.name: getPackageScopeConfig
methods.description: Finds the nearest package.json upwards from a resolved URL.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to an existing file.

methods.name: legacyMainResolve
methods.description: Resolves the main entry point of a package based on package.json 'main' field and fallback index files.

methods.name: resolveExtensionsWithTryExactName
methods.description: Resolves a file with known extensions or tries exact name resolution.

methods.name: resolveExtensions
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a file by appending known extensions.

methods.name: resolveIndex
methods.description: Resolves an index file within a directory.

methods.name: finalizeResolution
methods.description: Finalizes module resolution, handling directory and encoding checks, and appending extensions or index files as needed.

methods.name: throwImportNotDefined
methods.description: Throws an error if an import specifier is not defined in package imports.

methods.name: throwExportsNotFound
methods.description: Throws an error if a package export subpath is not found.

methods.name: throwInvalidSubpath
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid subpath requests.

methods.name: throwInvalidPackageTarget
methods.description: Throws an error for invalid package target configurations.

methods.name: resolvePackageTargetString
methods.description: Resolves a package target string, handling patterns and subpaths.

methods.name: isArrayIndex
methods.description: Checks if a string key is a valid array index.

methods.name: resolvePackageTarget
methods.description: Resolves package target configurations, including objects, arrays, and strings.

methods.name: isConditionalExportsMainSugar
methods.description: Determines if 'exports' uses the main sugar pattern.

methods.name: packageExportsResolve
methods.description: Resolves package exports based on package.json 'exports' field.

methods.name: packageImportsResolve
methods.description: Resolves internal package imports based on package.json 'imports' field.

methods.name: getPackageType
methods.description: Retrieves the package type ('module' or 'commonjs') from package.json.

methods.name: parsePackageName
methods.description: Parses a package specifier into package name, subpath, and scope.

methods.name: packageResolve
methods.description: Resolves a package specifier to a URL, handling node_modules lookup and package.json configurations.

methods.name: isBareSpecifier
methods.description: Checks if a specifier is a bare module specifier.

methods.name: isRelativeSpecifier
methods.description: Checks if a specifier is a relative path.

methods.name: shouldBeTreatedAsRelativeOrAbsolutePath
methods.description: Determines if a specifier should be treated as a relative or absolute path.

methods.name: moduleResolve
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to a URL, handling relative, package, and URL specifiers.

methods.name: resolveAsCommonJS
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a module specifier as a CommonJS module.

methods.name: defaultResolve
methods.description: Default module resolution function used by Node.js for ESM specifiers.
